newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GANGULY AND DHARMANI AWAIT DISCIPLINARY DECISION.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GANGULY AND DHARMANI AWAIT DISCIPLINARY DECISION.

text.p: Indian batsman Saurav Ganguly and substitute fielder Pankaj Dharmani are facing charges of bringing the game into disrepute and intimidating an umpire in third test against South Africa which ended in a draw at the Wanderers on Monday.
Both players appeared at a disciplinary meeting with match referee Barry Jarman who said both had "charged at umpire Peter Willey" after a bat-pad appeal against batsman Adam Bacher was turned down.
Jarman said that after hearing evidence from all concerned he had decided to delay his decision until Tuesday.
